why_ai: Pure software platforms run on recommenders and pipelines; catalogue licences and scale are the moat.
why_clarity: Streams and engagement are measured instantly, but fair allocation and curation are contested.
why_digital: Audio files and logs in, streams and statements out, sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Payout arithmetic is computable, but choosing a model is policy negotiated with labels and artists.
why_clarity: Each model's payouts are exact, but which is right is a contested policy question.
why_digital: Listening logs in, modelled payouts out, argued in industry negotiations.

why_ai: Classifying and screening a hundred thousand tracks daily is volume detection only machines can do.
why_clarity: Each track gets a classification and admit decision across huge, near-identical volume.
why_digital: Audio and metadata files in, catalogue decisions out, all automated.

why_ai: Matching recordings to rights records with audio evidence is a direct ML entity-resolution task.
why_clarity: A recording either matches an owner record or remains unattributed.
why_digital: Recordings and metadata in, matched rights records out.

why_ai: Editors' taste decides placements that make careers, though triage of pitches automates.
why_clarity: Good playlisting is taste; editors listen and judge by feel at high volume.
why_digital: Pitched tracks in, playlists out, entirely online.

why_ai: Analysis over listening data the platform already holds is exactly what AI-generated reporting does.
why_clarity: Reports are defined from logs, but which insights help artists decide is looser.
why_digital: Listening logs in, dashboards and reports out.

why_ai: Recommenders are ML systems already; the work is modelling, not personal accountability.
why_clarity: Engagement is measured instantly in A/B tests, though the right objective is contested.
why_digital: Listening behaviour in, ranked recommendations out, delivered in-app.

why_ai: Allocation is computable from logs, though contractual audit rights and label disputes add accountability.
why_clarity: A formula applied monthly to streams produces exact, auditable payouts.
why_digital: Stream logs in, royalty statements and payments out.

why_ai: Adversarial fraud detection against improving bots needs ongoing judgment, but is done by models.
why_clarity: Streams are scored at volume, yet true fraud labels are rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Behavioural logs in, fraud flags and withheld payments out.

why_ai: Explaining payments and exposure to artists is evidence generation AI can provide at scale.
why_clarity: Artist questions repeat across thousands of accounts with derivable answers.
why_digital: Platform data in, explanations and dashboards delivered online to remote artists.

why_ai: Matching recordings and reconciling statements across intermediaries is spreadsheet work AI absorbs.
why_clarity: Statements reconcile or they do not, across thousands of recurring cases.
why_digital: Statements and rights data from a dozen sources, reconciled on screen.
